en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ayoub Bin Al Hurr, a brother of Adeym, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who says ten times, ‘O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>!’, it would be said to him: ‘At your service! What is your need?’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Ayyub ibn al-Hurr brother of ‘Udaym from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Whoever says ten times, ‘O Lord.’ It will be said to him, “Your call for help is well heard and noted. What kind of help do you need?’”
